what: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
text: senaceR provides R interface official SENACE Open Data Portal, operated Peru’s National Service Environmental Certification Sustainable Investments (Servicio Nacional de Certificación Ambiental para las Inversiones Sostenibles). retrieves official REST API datastreams directly tidy R data structures (tibble) bundles compressed local snapshots offline analysis resilient fallback operation.

title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
text: Direct REST API Integration: Access SENACE’s live endpoints using personal API key (auth_key). Tidy Tabular Data: responses automatically formatted modern tibble objects. Offline & Fallback Mode: Includes pre-packaged, compressed local datasets (LazyData). live API unreachable, senaceR gracefully falls back bundled snapshots informative warning. Unified Datastreams: Consolidates subdivided web portal views (e.g. 10 sector views consulting firms) clean, unified master datasets.

title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data

what: Architecture: API Datastreams vs. Web Catalog
title: Programmatic Access to SENACE Open Data
text: SENACE Web Portal lists 22 items online catalog, official REST API consolidates 8 core Datastreams: Project Portfolio (3 web views → 1 API Datastream): portal breaks projects separate pages (Approved, Evaluation, Disapproved). API datastream CarteraProyectos returns projects single table. Consulting Firms (10 web views → 1 API Datastream): portal lists firms individual subsector (Agriculture, Mining, Energy, Transport, etc.). API datastream ConsultorasAmbientales consolidates registered firms across subsectors. Web-Views: Items Especialistas, Participación Ciudadana, Viáticos web-portal displays without dedicated public REST API endpoints.
